name: Fairmont Nile City Hotel
positioning: Art Deco-style Fairmont hotel (Fairmont Nile City) in the city center of Cairo, with Nile and skyline views and a rooftop Sky Pool
best_for: Travelers who want a Nile-view city base in central Cairo
Guests who like a private lounge and butler service with Fairmont Gold

facts.text: The hotel is in the city center of Cairo, at 2005 B, Corniche El Nil, Ramlet Beaulac.
Rooms combine Art Deco and contemporary design, with 100% Egyptian cotton bedding.
Fairmont Gold is a private hotel-within-a-hotel experience across three dedicated floors.
The Sky Pool is on the 25th floor and has views of the Nile and the Cairo skyline, with glimpses of the Giza Pyramids on clear days.
Dining venues include L'Uliveto, Gingko, Bab El Nil, La Mie and Onyx Lounge, and all are open to outside visitors.
The Fairmont Spa is open to hotel guests and outside visitors, and guests must be 18 or older.
The fitness center offers personal training and is on the same wellness floor as the Fairmont Spa.
Cairo International Airport is the closest airport, about 30 minutes away by car.

highlights.text: The Sky Pool is on the 25th floor, with views of the Nile and the Cairo skyline, and glimpses of the Giza Pyramids on clear days.
Fairmont Gold is a private hotel-within-a-hotel experience across three dedicated floors.
The Presidential Suite has a full Nile view, two bedrooms, a kitchen and four bathrooms.
The hotel's design is Art Deco, with views of the Nile or the Cairo skyline.
Fairmont Gold rooms come with 24-hour on-call butler service and access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge.

considerations.text: Reservations are required for the Sky Pool.
Indoor parking and valet parking are available for an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes an urban city location with traffic noise.
